layout.heroStructure: centered-left-aligned top nav with large two-line headline, supporting subcopy, dual CTA buttons, and a secondary text link all left-aligned within a wide container, followed below by a large rounded-corner product screenshot panel bleeding toward viewport edges
layout.grid: single-column content flow with a wide full-bleed media panel beneath the hero text block; no visible multi-column card grid in the captured fold
layout.containerWidth: wide fluid container roughly 1280-1440px max-width with generous horizontal margins on desktop, collapsing to near-full-width with ~20px side padding on mobile
layout.contentAlignment: left-aligned text block for headline/subcopy/CTAs, with the screenshot panel centered and inset below
layout.imagePlacement: single large interactive-UI screenshot placed directly beneath the hero copy, framed in a rounded dark panel that reads as an embedded product demo
layout.header: fixed-height minimal top bar with logo-left, horizontal text nav with dropdown chevrons in the center-left cluster, and login/signup actions right-aligned; mobile collapses nav into a hamburger icon

typography.fontPersonality: modern grotesque sans-serif, geometric and slightly condensed, feels engineered rather than warm
typography.headingScale: hero headline roughly 2.5-3x body text size, wrapping across two lines at desktop width and three-plus lines on mobile
typography.weight: heavy/bold weight on headline, medium weight on nav and buttons, regular weight on body copy
typography.lineHeight: tight line-height on headline (around 1.05-1.1) for compact multi-line stacking, looser (around 1.4-1.5) on body subcopy
typography.letterSpacing: default to slightly tight tracking on headline, normal tracking on nav and body text
typography.hierarchy: clear three-tier hierarchy: small nav labels, oversized bold headline as primary focal point, medium-weight muted subcopy directly beneath

color.saturation: near-desaturated monochrome palette with one isolated saturated accent used sparingly for interactive glow/highlight moments
color.temperature: cool overall temperature from near-black base and neutral grays, punctuated by a cool blue accent

photography.composition: screen-capture-style product UI shown inside a rounded device-like frame rather than lifestyle photography
photography.lighting: simulated screen glow with a soft radial light bloom emanating from a central interactive element against the dark surface
photography.colorGrading: high-contrast near-monochrome grade with deep blacks and a single cool-toned glow accent
photography.cameraAngle: flat frontal angle, no perspective tilt, as if looking directly at a screen
photography.depthOfField: sharp overall focus with a soft glow/blur halo used only around the highlighted UI element for emphasis
photography.humanPose: not applicable — no human subjects present, interface-only visual
photography.environment: abstract dark digital environment representing a software canvas/workspace rather than a physical setting
photography.texture: smooth flat digital texture with subtle noise-free gradients and soft glow diffusion
photography.imageRatio: wide landscape ratio around 16:9 to 2:1 on desktop, taller near-square to portrait crop on mobile

components.buttons: pill-to-rounded-rectangle buttons with solid white fill for primary action and dark filled/outlined style for secondary action, compact horizontal padding
components.cards: dark surface panels with soft rounded corners used to frame the product screenshot and inline UI chips, no visible drop shadow separation from background
components.forms: not visible in this fold; cookie-consent bar implies simple flat rectangular button inputs with minimal styling
components.navigation: horizontal top nav bar with text links, dropdown-caret indicators on grouped items, and distinct visual treatment for auth actions (ghost text link vs solid filled button)
components.border: thin, low-contrast hairline borders separating panel sections, barely visible against the dark background
components.radius: medium-large corner radius (roughly 12-20px) applied consistently to buttons, panels, and the hero media frame
components.shadow: minimal to no elevation shadow; depth communicated instead through subtle surface-color contrast and glow effects

spacing.sectionGap: generous vertical gap (roughly 80-120px equivalent) between header, hero text, and the media panel below
spacing.containerPadding: wide side padding on desktop (~80-100px), narrow side padding on mobile (~20px)
spacing.cardPadding: moderate internal padding (~24-32px) inside the dark UI panel framing the product screenshot
spacing.contentGap: compact vertical rhythm between headline, subcopy, and CTA row (~16-24px increments)
spacing.heroWhitespace: ample surrounding negative space around the hero text block and above the media panel, reinforcing a spacious, uncluttered first impression

motion.fade: subtle fade-in suggested for hero text elements on load, consistent with a calm entrance rather than abrupt appearance
motion.reveal: progressive reveal of the product screenshot panel as if demonstrating a live interactive build process
motion.scroll: likely scroll-triggered section transitions beyond the captured fold, not confirmed from static screenshot
motion.hover: interactive UI chips (tab-style toggles, dropdown rows) imply hover-state highlighting with a lightened surface tone
motion.transition: smooth, moderate-duration easing implied by the soft glow diffusion and rounded panel treatment, avoiding abrupt or bouncy motion
